sources.name: NYC Council Legistar API
sources.publisher_cadence: Updated as meetings, agenda items, and votes change

ingest.transform: Normalize and join → D1/KV read model

sources.approach: Daily edge materialization (cron) fetches authenticated Events (180-day window), strict-joins City Record hearing notices, and materializes EventItems (agenda + matters + outcomes), best-effort roll-call votes, item attachments, and hearing documents (agenda/minutes PDFs) into the meeting-outcomes KV read model. Token reaches the Worker as secret LEGISTAR_API_TOKEN, synced idempotently from the GitHub Actions secret on each deploy.
sources.coverage: Materialized (2026-07-30): daily edge ingest from authenticated webapi.legistar.com/v1/nyc with the strict exact_date_body_tokens join (modern event join 100%, 59/59). EventItems carry inline matters (98.3%) and action outcomes; best-effort roll-call votes and attachments are fetched for flagged items (~10% of events publish roll-call detail on the endpoint). Hearing agenda/minutes PDFs surface at the event level. Remaining sub-gap: pre-modern (pre-2025) historical events join at 73% and sparse roll-call detail is often not published on the endpoint for subcommittee voice votes.
sources.known_gap: Materialized (2026-07-30): daily edge ingest from authenticated webapi.legistar.com/v1/nyc with the strict exact_date_body_tokens join (modern event join 100%, 59/59). Hearing agenda/minutes PDFs surface at the event level.
